<?php
/**
 * Area Pages: writes the site's look (fonts, sizes, line spacing, buttons) into the
 * Theme Builder template itself, so the template shows the site design and every later
 * change is made in the Theme Builder. After this the plugin forces no typography CSS.
 *
 * @package SEO_Boster
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

class SEOB_AP_Bake {

	/* ==================================================================
	 * Values
	 * ================================================================== */

	/** "rgb(200, 16, 46)" => "#c8102e"; keeps rgba with transparency. */
	public static function color( $v ) {
		$v = trim( (string) $v );
		if ( preg_match( '/^#[0-9a-f]{3,8}$/i', $v ) ) {
			return $v;
		}
		if ( 'transparent' === $v ) {
			return 'rgba(0,0,0,0)';
		}
		if ( preg_match( '/^rgba?\(\s*(\d+)[\s,]+(\d+)[\s,]+(\d+)(?:[\s,\/]+([\d.]+%?))?\s*\)$/', $v, $m ) ) {
			$a = isset( $m[4] ) ? $m[4] : '1';
			$a = '%' === substr( $a, -1 ) ? (float) $a / 100 : (float) $a;
			if ( $a < 1 ) {
				return 'rgba(' . (int) $m[1] . ',' . (int) $m[2] . ',' . (int) $m[3] . ',' . round( $a, 2 ) . ')';
			}
			return sprintf( '#%02x%02x%02x', min( 255, (int) $m[1] ), min( 255, (int) $m[2] ), min( 255, (int) $m[3] ) );
		}
		return '';
	}

	public static function family( $f ) {
		$f = explode( ',', (string) $f );
		return trim( $f[0], " \"'" );
	}

	private static function weight( $w ) {
		if ( 'bold' === $w ) {
			return '700';
		}
		return preg_match( '/^[1-9]00$/', (string) $w ) ? (string) $w : '';
	}

	/** Relative line height "1.30" => "1.3em". */
	private static function lh( $v ) {
		if ( ! is_numeric( $v ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		return rtrim( rtrim( number_format( (float) $v, 2, '.', '' ), '0' ), '.' ) . 'em';
	}

	private static function px( $v ) {
		$n = (float) $v;
		return rtrim( rtrim( number_format( $n, 1, '.', '' ), '0' ), '.' ) . 'px';
	}

	/**
	 * One measured style for a tag at all three screen sizes.
	 *
	 * @return array [ desktop => [], tablet => [], phone => [] ]
	 */
	private static function sizes( array $d, $tag ) {
		$out = array();
		foreach ( array( 'desktop', 'tablet', 'phone' ) as $s ) {
			$out[ $s ] = isset( $d[ $s ][ $tag ] ) && is_array( $d[ $s ][ $tag ] ) ? $d[ $s ][ $tag ] : array();
		}
		if ( 'h4' === $tag && empty( $out['desktop'] ) ) {
			return self::sizes( $d, 'h3' );
		}
		if ( 'btn2' === $tag && empty( $out['desktop'] ) ) {
			return self::sizes( $d, 'btn' );
		}
		return $out;
	}

	/* ==================================================================
	 * Divi
	 * ================================================================== */

	/** Divi font string: family|weight|italic|uppercase|underline|smallcaps|strike|linecolor|linestyle. */
	private static function divi_font( array $x ) {
		$fam = self::family( isset( $x['fontFamily'] ) ? $x['fontFamily'] : '' );
		if ( '' === $fam || ! preg_match( '/^[A-Za-z0-9 \-_.]+$/', $fam ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		$w  = self::weight( isset( $x['fontWeight'] ) ? $x['fontWeight'] : '' );
		$it = isset( $x['fontStyle'] ) && 'italic' === $x['fontStyle'] ? 'on' : '';
		$up = isset( $x['textTransform'] ) && 'uppercase' === $x['textTransform'] ? 'on' : '';
		$un = isset( $x['textDecorationLine'] ) && 'underline' === $x['textDecorationLine'] ? 'on' : '';
		return $fam . '|' . $w . '|' . $it . '|' . $up . '|' . $un . '||||';
	}

	/**
	 * Font, size (desktop / tablet / phone), line height and letter spacing for one Divi prefix.
	 *
	 * @param array  $a      Attributes.
	 * @param string $prefix Like "header_2" or "text".
	 * @param array  $st     sizes() result.
	 * @param bool   $fonts_only Only family and weight (for heading levels the site does not use).
	 */
	private static function divi_text( array &$a, $prefix, array $st, $fonts_only = false ) {
		$x = $st['desktop'];
		if ( ! $x ) {
			return;
		}
		$font = self::divi_font( $x );
		if ( $font ) {
			$a[ $prefix . '_font' ] = $font;
		}
		if ( $fonts_only ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$a[ $prefix . '_font_size' ] = self::px( $x['fontSize'] );
			$t = isset( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) ? self::px( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) : '';
			$p = isset( $st['phone']['fontSize'] ) ? self::px( $st['phone']['fontSize'] ) : '';
			if ( $t || $p ) {
				$a[ $prefix . '_font_size_tablet' ]      = $t ? $t : $a[ $prefix . '_font_size' ];
				$a[ $prefix . '_font_size_phone' ]       = $p ? $p : $a[ $prefix . '_font_size_tablet' ];
				$a[ $prefix . '_font_size_last_edited' ] = 'on|phone';
			}
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['lineHeight'] ) && self::lh( $x['lineHeight'] ) ) {
			$a[ $prefix . '_line_height' ] = self::lh( $x['lineHeight'] );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['letterSpacing'] ) && 'normal' !== $x['letterSpacing'] ) {
			$a[ $prefix . '_letter_spacing' ] = $x['letterSpacing'];
		}
	}

	private static function pad( array $x ) {
		$v = array();
		foreach ( array( 'paddingTop', 'paddingRight', 'paddingBottom', 'paddingLeft' ) as $k ) {
			$v[] = isset( $x[ $k ] ) ? self::px( $x[ $k ] ) : '';
		}
		return implode( '|', $v ) . '|false|false';
	}

	/** Extra looks Divi has no simple field for (shadow, gradient): kept in the module's Custom CSS. */
	private static function extra_css( $old, array $x ) {
		$old = preg_replace( '/(box-shadow|background-image|transition)\s*:[^;]*;?/i', '', (string) $old );
		$add = '';
		if ( ! empty( $x['boxShadow'] ) && 'none' !== $x['boxShadow'] ) {
			$add .= 'box-shadow:' . $x['boxShadow'] . ';';
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['backgroundImage'] ) && 'none' !== $x['backgroundImage'] ) {
			$add .= 'background-image:' . $x['backgroundImage'] . ';';
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['transitionDuration'] ) && '0s' !== $x['transitionDuration'] ) {
			$add .= 'transition:all ' . $x['transitionDuration'] . ' ease;';
		}
		return trim( $old . $add );
	}

	/** Divi Next dual button (the SCO layout's "Call Now" / "Contact Us"). */
	private static function divi_dual( array &$a, $n, array $st, array $hover ) {
		$x = $st['desktop'];
		if ( ! $x ) {
			return;
		}
		$k = 'one' === $n ? 'one' : 'two';
		$font = self::divi_font( $x );
		if ( $font ) {
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_font' ] = $font;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_font_size' ] = self::px( $x['fontSize'] );
			if ( ! empty( $st['phone']['fontSize'] ) ) {
				$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_font_size_tablet' ]      = ! empty( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) ? self::px( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) : self::px( $x['fontSize'] );
				$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_font_size_phone' ]       = self::px( $st['phone']['fontSize'] );
				$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_font_size_last_edited' ] = 'on|phone';
			}
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['letterSpacing'] ) && 'normal' !== $x['letterSpacing'] ) {
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_letter_spacing' ] = $x['letterSpacing'];
		}
		$color = self::color( isset( $x['color'] ) ? $x['color'] : '' );
		if ( $color ) {
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_text_color' ] = $color;
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_icon_color' ]       = $color;
		}
		$bg = self::color( isset( $x['backgroundColor'] ) ? $x['backgroundColor'] : '' );
		if ( $bg ) {
			$a[ 'one' === $k ? 'btn_one_show_hide' : 'btn_two_color_show_hide' ] = 'on';
			$a[ 'button_bg_' . $k ] = $bg;
		}
		if ( isset( $x['borderRadius'] ) ) {
			$r = self::px( $x['borderRadius'] );
			$a[ 'border_radii_' . $k . '_border' ] = 'on|' . $r . '|' . $r . '|' . $r . '|' . $r;
		}
		if ( isset( $x['borderWidth'] ) ) {
			$a[ 'border_width_all_' . $k . '_border' ] = isset( $x['borderStyle'] ) && 'none' === $x['borderStyle'] ? '0px' : self::px( $x['borderWidth'] );
		}
		$bc = self::color( isset( $x['borderColor'] ) ? $x['borderColor'] : '' );
		if ( $bc ) {
			$a[ 'border_color_all_' . $k . '_border' ] = $bc;
		}
		$a[ 'button_' . $k . '_padding' ] = self::pad( $x );
		unset( $a[ 'button_' . $k . '_padding_tablet' ], $a[ 'button_' . $k . '_padding_phone' ], $a[ 'button_' . $k . '_padding_last_edited' ] );

		// Hover: the site's hover color (or the normal color when the site has no hover change).
		$hbg = self::color( isset( $hover['backgroundColor'] ) ? $hover['backgroundColor'] : '' );
		$a[ 'dnxt_dual_' . $k . '_hover_bg_color' ] = $hbg ? $hbg : ( $bg ? $bg : ( isset( $a[ 'dnxt_dual_' . $k . '_hover_bg_color' ] ) ? $a[ 'dnxt_dual_' . $k . '_hover_bg_color' ] : '' ) );
		$hc = self::color( isset( $hover['color'] ) ? $hover['color'] : '' );
		$hc = $hc ? $hc : $color;
		if ( $hc ) {
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_text_color__hover' ]         = $hc;
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_fonts_text_color__hover_enabled' ] = 'on|hover';
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_icon_color__hover' ]               = $hc;
			$a[ 'btn_' . $k . '_icon_color__hover_enabled' ]       = 'on|hover';
		}
		$hb = self::color( isset( $hover['borderColor'] ) ? $hover['borderColor'] : '' );
		if ( $hb ) {
			$a[ 'border_color_all_' . $k . '_border__hover' ]         = $hb;
			$a[ 'border_color_all_' . $k . '_border__hover_enabled' ] = 'on|hover';
		}
		$css_key       = 'custom_css_button_' . $k . '_link';
		$a[ $css_key ] = self::extra_css( isset( $a[ $css_key ] ) ? $a[ $css_key ] : '', $x );
		if ( '' === $a[ $css_key ] ) {
			unset( $a[ $css_key ] );
		}
	}

	/** Divi's own Button module. */
	private static function divi_button( array &$a, array $st, array $hover ) {
		$x = $st['desktop'];
		if ( ! $x ) {
			return;
		}
		$a['custom_button'] = 'on';
		$font               = self::divi_font( $x );
		if ( $font ) {
			$a['button_font'] = $font;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$a['button_text_size'] = self::px( $x['fontSize'] );
			if ( ! empty( $st['phone']['fontSize'] ) ) {
				$a['button_text_size_tablet']      = ! empty( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) ? self::px( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) : self::px( $x['fontSize'] );
				$a['button_text_size_phone']       = self::px( $st['phone']['fontSize'] );
				$a['button_text_size_last_edited'] = 'on|phone';
			}
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['letterSpacing'] ) && 'normal' !== $x['letterSpacing'] ) {
			$a['button_letter_spacing'] = $x['letterSpacing'];
		}
		$map = array(
			'color'           => 'button_text_color',
			'backgroundColor' => 'button_bg_color',
			'borderColor'     => 'button_border_color',
		);
		foreach ( $map as $prop => $attr ) {
			$c = self::color( isset( $x[ $prop ] ) ? $x[ $prop ] : '' );
			if ( $c ) {
				$a[ $attr ] = $c;
			}
			$h = self::color( isset( $hover[ $prop ] ) ? $hover[ $prop ] : '' );
			if ( $h ) {
				$a[ $attr . '__hover' ]         = $h;
				$a[ $attr . '__hover_enabled' ] = 'on|hover';
			}
		}
		if ( isset( $x['borderWidth'] ) ) {
			$a['button_border_width'] = isset( $x['borderStyle'] ) && 'none' === $x['borderStyle'] ? '0px' : self::px( $x['borderWidth'] );
		}
		if ( isset( $x['borderRadius'] ) ) {
			$a['button_border_radius'] = self::px( $x['borderRadius'] );
		}
		$a['custom_padding'] = self::pad( $x );
		$a['custom_css_main_element'] = self::extra_css( isset( $a['custom_css_main_element'] ) ? $a['custom_css_main_element'] : '', $x );
		if ( '' === $a['custom_css_main_element'] ) {
			unset( $a['custom_css_main_element'] );
		}
	}

	private static function parse_attrs( $text ) {
		$a = array();
		if ( preg_match_all( '/([A-Za-z0-9_]+)="([^"]*)"/', $text, $m, PREG_SET_ORDER ) ) {
			foreach ( $m as $x ) {
				$a[ $x[1] ] = $x[2];
			}
		}
		return $a;
	}

	private static function build_attrs( array $a ) {
		$out = '';
		foreach ( $a as $k => $v ) {
			$out .= ' ' . $k . '="' . str_replace( array( '"', '[', ']' ), array( '%22', '%91', '%93' ), (string) $v ) . '"';
		}
		return $out;
	}

	/**
	 * Write the measured site look into Divi layout shortcodes.
	 *
	 * @param string $content Layout content.
	 * @param array  $d       Measured data (SEOB_AP_Style data).
	 */
	public static function divi( $content, array $d ) {
		$h = array(
			'h1'  => self::sizes( $d, 'h1' ),
			'h2'  => self::sizes( $d, 'h2' ),
			'h3'  => self::sizes( $d, 'h3' ),
			'h4'  => self::sizes( $d, 'h4' ),
			'p'   => self::sizes( $d, 'p' ),
			'b1'  => self::sizes( $d, 'btn' ),
			'b2'  => self::sizes( $d, 'btn2' ),
		);
		$hov1 = isset( $d['desktop']['btn_hover'] ) ? (array) $d['desktop']['btn_hover'] : array();
		$hov2 = isset( $d['desktop']['btn2_hover'] ) ? (array) $d['desktop']['btn2_hover'] : ( empty( $d['desktop']['btn2'] ) ? $hov1 : array() );
		return preg_replace_callback(
			'/\[(et_pb_text|et_pb_accordion_item|et_pb_accordion|et_pb_toggle|dnxte_dual_button|et_pb_button)((?:\s+[A-Za-z0-9_]+="[^"]*")*)\s*(\/?)\]/',
			static function ( $m ) use ( $h, $hov1, $hov2 ) {
				$a = self::parse_attrs( $m[2] );
				switch ( $m[1] ) {
					case 'et_pb_text':
						self::divi_text( $a, 'header', $h['h1'] );
						self::divi_text( $a, 'header_2', $h['h2'] );
						self::divi_text( $a, 'header_3', $h['h3'] );
						self::divi_text( $a, 'header_4', $h['h4'] );
						foreach ( array( 'header_5', 'header_6' ) as $px ) {
							if ( isset( $a[ $px . '_font' ] ) ) {
								self::divi_text( $a, $px, $h['h2'], true );
							}
						}
						self::divi_text( $a, 'text', $h['p'] );
						break;
					case 'et_pb_accordion':
					case 'et_pb_toggle':
						self::divi_text( $a, 'toggle', $h['h4'] );
						self::divi_text( $a, 'closed_toggle', $h['h4'], true );
						self::divi_text( $a, 'body', $h['p'] );
						break;
					case 'et_pb_accordion_item':
						self::divi_text( $a, 'body', $h['p'] );
						break;
					case 'dnxte_dual_button':
						self::divi_dual( $a, 'one', $h['b1'], $hov1 );
						self::divi_dual( $a, 'two', $h['b2'], $hov2 );
						break;
					case 'et_pb_button':
						self::divi_button( $a, $h['b1'], $hov1 );
						break;
				}
				return '[' . $m[1] . self::build_attrs( $a ) . ( $m[3] ? ' /' : '' ) . ']';
			},
			$content
		);
	}

	/** The Divi body layout used by the SEO Boster Theme Builder template. */
	public static function divi_body_id() {
		$tpl = (int) SEOB_AP_Design::settings()['divi_template'];
		if ( ! $tpl || 'et_template' !== get_post_type( $tpl ) ) {
			return 0;
		}
		$body = (int) get_post_meta( $tpl, '_et_body_layout_id', true );
		return $body && 'et_body_layout' === get_post_type( $body ) ? $body : 0;
	}

	/* ==================================================================
	 * Elementor
	 * ================================================================== */

	private static function el_size( $v, $unit = 'px' ) {
		return array( 'unit' => $unit, 'size' => (float) $v, 'sizes' => array() );
	}

	private static function el_type( array &$s, $prefix, array $st, $fonts_only = false ) {
		$x = $st['desktop'];
		if ( ! $x ) {
			return;
		}
		$s[ $prefix . 'typography' ] = 'custom';
		$fam = self::family( isset( $x['fontFamily'] ) ? $x['fontFamily'] : '' );
		if ( $fam ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_family' ] = $fam;
		}
		$w = self::weight( isset( $x['fontWeight'] ) ? $x['fontWeight'] : '' );
		if ( $w ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_weight' ] = $w;
		}
		if ( $fonts_only ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_size' ] = self::el_size( $x['fontSize'] );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_size_tablet' ] = self::el_size( $st['tablet']['fontSize'] );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $st['phone']['fontSize'] ) ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_size_mobile' ] = self::el_size( $st['phone']['fontSize'] );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['lineHeight'] ) && is_numeric( $x['lineHeight'] ) ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'line_height' ] = self::el_size( $x['lineHeight'], 'em' );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['letterSpacing'] ) && 'normal' !== $x['letterSpacing'] ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'letter_spacing' ] = self::el_size( $x['letterSpacing'] );
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['textTransform'] ) ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'text_transform' ] = $x['textTransform'];
		}
		if ( ! empty( $x['fontStyle'] ) && 'normal' !== $x['fontStyle'] ) {
			$s[ $prefix . 'font_style' ] = $x['fontStyle'];
		}
	}

	private static function el_button( array &$s, array $st, array $hover ) {
		$x = $st['desktop'];
		if ( ! $x ) {
			return;
		}
		self::el_type( $s, 'typography_', $st );
		$map = array(
			'color'           => array( 'button_text_color', 'hover_color' ),
			'backgroundColor' => array( 'background_color', 'button_background_hover_color' ),
			'borderColor'     => array( 'border_color', 'button_hover_border_color' ),
		);
		foreach ( $map as $prop => $keys ) {
			$c = self::color( isset( $x[ $prop ] ) ? $x[ $prop ] : '' );
			if ( $c ) {
				$s[ $keys[0] ] = $c;
			}

	private static function el_walk( array $els, array $h, array $hov1, array $hov2, &$btn_n ) {
		foreach ( $els as $i => $e ) {
			if ( isset( $e['elType'] ) && 'widget' === $e['elType'] && isset( $e['settings'] ) && is_array( $e['settings'] ) ) {
				$s = $e['settings'];
				switch ( $e['widgetType'] ) {
					case 'heading':
						$tag = isset( $s['header_size'] ) ? $s['header_size'] : 'h2';
						$key = in_array( $tag, array( 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4' ), true ) ? $tag : ( in_array( $tag, array( 'h5', 'h6' ), true ) ? 'h4' : 'p' );
						self::el_type( $s, 'typography_', $h[ $key ] );
						break;
					case 'text-editor':
						self::el_type( $s, 'typography_', $h['p'] );
						break;
					case 'button':
						// Buttons alternate main / second style the way they sit side by side in the layout.
						$second = 1 === ( $btn_n % 2 ) && ! empty( $h['b2']['desktop'] );
						self::el_button( $s, $second ? $h['b2'] : $h['b1'], $second ? $hov2 : $hov1 );
						++$btn_n;
						break;
					case 'nested-accordion':
					case 'accordion':
					case 'toggle':
						self::el_type( $s, 'title_typography_', $h['h4'] );
						self::el_type( $s, 'content_typography_', $h['p'] );
						break;
				}
				$els[ $i ]['settings'] = $s;
			}
			if ( ! empty( $e['elements'] ) && is_array( $e['elements'] ) ) {
				$els[ $i ]['elements'] = self::el_walk( $e['elements'], $h, $hov1, $hov2, $btn_n );
			}
		}
		return $els;
	}

	public static function elementor( array $els, array $d ) {

			'h2' => self::sizes( $d, 'h2' ),
			'h3' => self::sizes( $d, 'h3' ),
			'h4' => self::sizes( $d, 'h4' ),
			'p'  => self::sizes( $d, 'p' ),
			'b1' => self::sizes( $d, 'btn' ),
			'b2' => self::sizes( $d, 'btn2' ),
		);
		$hov1  = isset( $d['desktop']['btn_hover'] ) ? (array) $d['desktop']['btn_hover'] : array();
		$hov2  = isset( $d['desktop']['btn2_hover'] ) ? (array) $d['desktop']['btn2_hover'] : array();

	/**
	 * Copy the measured site look into the Theme Builder template.
	 *
	 * @return string divi|elementor|'' (nothing to do).
	 */
	public static function apply() {
		$st = SEOB_AP_Style::get();
		$d  = $st['data'];
		if ( empty( $d['desktop'] ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		$mode = SEOB_AP_Design::settings()['mode'];
		$done = '';
		if ( 'divi' === $mode ) {
			$body = self::divi_body_id();
			if ( $body ) {
				$post = get_post( $body );
				$new  = self::divi( (string) $post->post_content, $d );
				if ( $new !== $post->post_content ) {
					wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $body, 'post_content' => wp_slash( $new ) ) );
				}
				if ( class_exists( 'ET_Core_PageResource' ) && method_exists( 'ET_Core_PageResource', 'remove_static_resources' ) ) {
					ET_Core_PageResource::remove_static_resources( 'all', 'all' );
				}
				$done = 'divi';
			}
		} elseif ( 'elementor' === $mode ) {
			$id = (int) SEOB_AP_Design::settings()['el_template'];
			if ( $id && get_post( $id ) ) {
				$els = json_decode( (string) get_post_meta( $id, '_elementor_data', true ), true );
				if ( is_array( $els ) ) {
					update_post_meta( $id, '_elementor_data', wp_slash( (string) wp_json_encode( self::elementor( $els, $d ) ) ) );
					delete_post_meta( $id, '_elementor_css' );
					if ( class_exists( '\Elementor\Plugin' ) && isset( \Elementor\Plugin::$instance->files_manager ) ) {
						\Elementor\Plugin::$instance->files_manager->clear_cache();
					}
					$done = 'elementor';
				}
			}
		}
		if ( $done ) {
			SEOB_AP_Style::save(
				array(
					'baked'      => $done,
					'baked_time' => time(),
				)
			);
		}
		return $done;
	}

	/** True when the Theme Builder template holds the site look (no forced CSS needed). */
	public static function is_baked() {
		$st   = SEOB_AP_Style::get();
		$mode = SEOB_AP_Design::settings()['mode'];
		return ! empty( $st['baked'] ) && $st['baked'] === $mode;
	}
}

content.text:
Ho gaya, version 1.8.2 taiyar hai. Ab design sirf Theme Builder se banta aur badalta hai. Yeh aapke **SEO DESGIN PROCESS** folder mein bhi save hai, aur handoff zip bhi update kar diya hai.

**Kya badla:**

1. **"Advanced: use the SEO Boster layout editor" hata diya.** Divi ya Elementor wali sites par Design tab mein ab sirf ek button hai: "Edit design in Divi > Theme Builder". Plugin ka apna layout editor ab sirf un sites par dikhega jahan koi builder nahi hai, kyunki wahan Theme Builder hota hi nahi.

2. **Site ka look ab template ke andar likha jaata hai.** Plugin homepage ko desktop, tablet aur phone par padhta hai. Phir ek baar yeh sab Theme Builder template ke modules mein bhar deta hai:
   - Headings aur paragraph ka font, size, weight, line spacing aur letter spacing (teeno screen sizes ke liye)
   - Buttons: font, size, text color, background, corners, border, padding, hover color, shadow
   - Dono buttons (Call Now aur Contact Us) alag alag style mein, aur FAQ ka font bhi

   Matlab aap Theme Builder khologe toh template pehle se site jaisa dikhega.

3. **Theme Builder ki edit hamesha dikhegi.** Pehle plugin CSS se style zabardasti lagata tha, isliye Theme Builder mein kiya gaya change dab jaata tha. Ab template mein look aa jaane ke baad plugin koi style force nahi karta. Theme Builder mein font, button ya color badlo, save karo, aur sab Area pages par wahi dikhega.

4. **"Copy the site look again" button:** yeh tabhi dabana jab site ke apne fonts ya buttons badlein. Yeh pehle confirm poochta hai, kyunki isse template mein kiye font aur button changes dobara site jaise ho jaate hain. Sections ke colors, text aur images nahi badalte.

**Testing:** maine yeh plugin ki asli Divi aur Elementor layout files par chalakar check kiya. Template ke saare 152 modules usi order mein rahe, saare 53 ACF dynamic fields bache rahe, aur content bilkul nahi badla. Dono screens bhi bina error ke khul rahe hain.

Live Divi site par yeh abhi test nahi hua hai, kyunki mere paas Divi nahi hai. Isliye pehla check Maeve par hi hoga.

**Maeve par yeh karo:**
1. 1.8.2 upload karo (Plugins > Add New > Upload > Replace current).
2. SEO Boster > Area Pages > **Setup** tab kholo aur page ko poora load hone do. Plugin site padhkar look khud template mein daal dega. Wahan "Copied into the Theme Builder template" likha aayega.
3. Divi > Theme Builder mein "Areas We Serve (SEO Boster)" template kholkar dekho ki fonts aur buttons site jaise hain ya nahi.

Upload karke batao, phir main Maeve par live pages check kar lunga.

content.text:
Menu fix ho gaya. Version 1.8.3 bhej diya hai, aur yeh **SEO DESGIN PROCESS** folder mein bhi save hai.

**Problem kya tha:** jab 5 se zyada locations hoti thi, plugin "Areas We Serve" par Divi ka "mega menu" setting laga deta tha. Aapki site ka header Divi Theme Builder ke Menu module se bana hai, aur wahan mega menu theek se kaam nahi karta. Dropdown sirf 310px chauda tha, isliye 12 locations ke columns ek doosre ke upar chadh gaye.

**Ab kaisa dikhega:**
- **Desktop:** locations ki ek saaf list aati hai, har location ke aage ek right arrow hota hai. Kisi location par mouse le jaao toh uski services bagal mein usi row ki line mein khulti hain. Agar right mein jagah nahi hai toh services left mein khulti hain aur arrow bhi palat jaata hai, taaki menu screen se bahar na jaaye.
- **Phone:** "Areas We Serve" tap karo toh locations khulti hain. Har location par ab arrow dikhta hai (theme pehle use chhupa raha tha), aur tap karne par uski services khul jaati hain.

**Test:** maine stapaverkings.com par yeh naya CSS aur script sirf browser mein temporarily lagakar desktop (1440px) aur phone (375px) dono par check kiya. Dono theek dikhe. Site par kuch save nahi kiya.

Purana menu dobara banane ki zarurat nahi hai. Plugin purane menu se bhi mega menu setting khud hata deta hai.

**Aapko bas yeh karna hai:** stapaverkings.com par 1.8.3 upload karo (Plugins > Add New > Upload > Replace current). Phir page ko ek baar hard refresh karo (Ctrl + F5), menu theek dikhega.

content.text:
Auto-fill ab har image cell bhar deta hai, haath se kuch nahi lagana padega. Version 1.8.4 bhej diya hai, aur yeh **SEO DESGIN PROCESS** folder mein bhi save hai.

**Pehle kuch cells khaali kyun reh jaate the (teen wajah):**
1. Plugin sirf woh photos leta tha jinke naam service se match karte the. Jis service ki matching photo nahi milti, uske cells khaali reh jaate the.
2. Jo photo ek service mein lag jaati, woh agli service ko nahi milti thi. Isliye neeche wali services ke liye photos khatam ho jaati thi.
3. "Section 5 icon" sirf pehli row mein bharta tha, baaki rows khaali dikhti thi.

**Ab Auto-fill aise kaam karta hai:**

content.text:
Version 1.8.5 taiyar hai. Isme buttons site jaise bante hain aur page har screen par theek dikhta hai. Yeh **SEO DESGIN PROCESS** folder mein bhi save hai.

Maine demo site ka Area page laptop (1280px), tablet (820px) aur phone (375px) par check kiya. Kisi bhi size par page side mein scroll nahi hota tha, lekin yeh problems mili aur ab fix ho gayi hain:

**Buttons:**
- Plugin ne galat "main" button chuna tha: sabse zyada use hone wala outline button. Ab main button site ka blue "Get a Free Estimate" wala style hai (hero ka bhara hua button), aur doosra button sand color wala.
- Divi Essential plugin ki default CSS Divi ke button styles ke baad load hoti thi. Isliye kuch buttons 20px text aur 3px corners ke saath blue dikhte the. Ab Area pages ke buttons hamesha site ke buttons ki exact copy hain, hover bhi.
- Agar koi button apne section ke rang mein ghul jaaye (jaise blue section par blue button), toh woh khud site ke doosre button style par chala jaata hai, taaki hamesha dikhe.

**Responsive layout:**
- Phone par "Contact Us" button 3 mein se 2 jagah chhupa hua tha. Ab dono buttons har screen par dikhte hain, ek line mein. Jagah kam ho toh agli line par aa jaate hain, aur bahut chhote phone par poori width ke ho jaate hain.
- Hero ka white heading halke blue-grey background par mushkil se padha ja raha tha. Ab hero mein page ki photo lagti hai, upar dark layer ke saath.
- Section 3 mein white text halke background par tha. Ab wahan usi brand color ka gehra shade lagta hai.
- FAQ ke sawaal halke background par white mein the, aur tablet par 12px ho jaate the. Ab rang padhne layak hain, size desktop, tablet aur phone ke hisaab se set hai, aur line spacing theek hai.

Yeh layout fixes Theme Builder template ke andar hi likhe jaate hain, ek baar, isliye wahan se edit kar sakte ho. Fonts aur aapke kiye hue edits nahi badlte.

**Testing:** fixes ko maine plugin ki asli Divi layout file par chalakar check kiya, aur button ka chunaav aur contrast switch local test site par. Demo site par naya version abhi install nahi hua hai, isliye wahan final check upload ke baad hoga.

**Demo site par yeh karo:**
1. 1.8.5 upload karo (Plugins > Add New > Upload > Replace current).
2. SEO Boster > Area Pages > **Setup** tab ek baar kholo aur page poora load hone do. Plugin site ko naye tareeke se dobara padhega aur template fixes laga dega.
3. Koi Area page Ctrl + F5 se refresh karke dekho.

Upload karke batao, phir main desktop, tablet aur phone teeno par live page dobara check kar dunga.

content.text:
Version 1.9.0 taiyar hai, aur ab plugin aapka naya Theme Builder layout use karta hai. Yeh **SEO DESGIN PROCESS** folder mein bhi save hai, handoff zip bhi update hai.

**Structure:** aapke layout ke 5 sections usi order mein aate hain:
1. Hero heading
2. Photo ke saath text aur "Call Now / Contact Us" buttons
3. Rangeen section, photo ke saath
4. FAQ
5. Background photo wala call-to-action

Section 4 aur 5 (6 boxes wale) ab template mein nahi hain.

**Jis site par plugin install hoga, wahan yeh sab us site jaisa hoga:**
- **Colors:** layout ka teal brand color us site ke main brand color mein badal jaata hai. Black, white aur grey waise hi rehte hain.
- **Typography:** headings (H1, H2, H3, aur bade display headings bhi), paragraph aur FAQ ka font, size aur line spacing site jaisa hota hai. Desktop, tablet aur phone teeno ke size alag set hote hain.
- **Buttons:** site ke buttons ki exact copy: font family, size, weight, colors, corners, padding aur hover.
- **Contrast:** agar site ka brand color halka hai aur us par white text aata hai, toh plugin usi rang ka gehra shade laga deta hai, taaki text padha ja sake.

**Responsive:** aapke layout ki responsive settings waise hi rehti hain. Upar se:
- Phone par "Contact Us" ab chhupta nahi.
- Section 3 mein "Learn More" button aapne jaan-boojhkar chhupaya hai, woh chhupa hi rahega.
- Buttons ek line mein aate hain, jagah kam ho toh neeche wrap ho jaate hain.

**Images:** Divi sites par image grid aur Auto-fill ab sirf woh 3 photos dikhate hain jo naya template use karta hai: Section 2, Section 3 aur Section 7 background. Aapki team bekaar photos nahi bharegi. AI phir bhi saare ACF fields likhta hai, taaki ACF data poora rahe.

**Testing:** maine naya layout plugin ke andar chalakar check kiya: structure aur saare dynamic fields same rahe, aur site ke fonts, sizes aur colors sahi jagah lage. Admin screens aur Auto-fill bhi bina error ke chale. Live Divi site par yeh abhi test nahi hua hai.

**Demo site par naya layout lagane ke liye:**
1. 1.9.0 upload karo (Plugins > Add New > Upload > Replace current).
2. SEO Boster > Area Pages > **Setup** mein "Install a fresh copy of the design" tick karke Setup chalao. Isse purane template mein kiye gaye edits replace ho jaayenge.
3. Divi > Theme Builder mein purana "Areas We Serve" template delete kar do, taaki sirf naya bache.
4. Koi Area page Ctrl + F5 se refresh karke dekho.

Nayi sites par yeh layout plugin install karte hi apne aap lag jaayega. Upload karke batao, phir main desktop, tablet aur phone par live check kar lunga.

1	# SEO Boster: Project Handoff
2	
3	Last updated: 16 November 2026. Plugin version at handoff: **1.3.1**.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 1. People and context
8	
9	- **Plugin author name (as shown in WordPress):** Rajvardhan Singh Rathore.
10	- **Who uses it:** a web agency's SEO and web team. They build service-business websites (mostly WordPress with Divi, some Elementor) and create many local SEO landing pages per client.
11	- **The person who commissioned this work** speaks Hinglish (Hindi + English in Latin script) and prefers short, clear answers. They do not want em dashes or en dashes in written replies.
12	- **Their computer:** Windows. Working folder: `C:\Users\digit\OneDrive\Desktop\SEO DESGIN PROCESS\` (this HANDOFF folder lives inside it).
13	
14	## 2. The goal
15	
16	Replace a slow manual process for building **"Areas We Serve" pages** (one page for every Service x Location combination, for example 8 services x 10 cities = 80 pages) with **one WordPress plugin** that does everything with as few clicks as possible, works on any client site, and keeps each site's data separate.
17	
18	### The old manual process (what the plugin replaces)
19	
20	1. Install the ACF plugin, import `inputs/acf-export-2025-12-20.json` (field group "Locations", post type `areas-we-serve`, taxonomy `location`).
21	2. Install the WP Ultimate CSV Importer Pro plugin.
22	3. Upload client images to the Media Library, copy their URLs.
23	4. Paste business name, services, keywords, locations, phone numbers and image URLs into a fixed ChatGPT prompt (`inputs/seo-team-chatgpt-prompt.txt`) to get a CSV.
24	5. Import the CSV into the "Areas We Serve" post type.
25	6. In Divi > Theme Builder, add a template for "All Areas We Serve", import `inputs/SCO Layout.json`, adjust branding (fonts, colors, buttons) to match the site.
26	7. Edit any single page later through its ACF fields in the WordPress editor.
27	
28	## 3. What the plugin does now (v1.9.0)
29	
30	Menu: **WordPress admin > SEO Boster**. It is built from modules; each module is a card on the SEO Boster dashboard and can be turned on or off.
31	
32	### Module A: Keyword Adder (v1.0.0)
33	Paste keywords. The plugin scores every page (title, URL, Yoast or Rank Math focus keyphrase, page text, synonyms such as corp = corporation, LLC = limited liability company, WY = Wyoming), picks the best page per keyword, writes a natural sentence containing it, lets you review or change everything, then adds the lines to the pages (rendered through `the_content`, the page's own content is never rewritten). Report shows page, line number, exact text, and a direct link to the line (`page-url#seob-line-3`). Undo per keyword or per run. CSV export.
34	
35	### Module B: Area Pages (v1.1.0 to v1.3.1)
36	Tabs inside **SEO Boster > Area Pages**:
37	
38	| Tab | What it does |
39	|-----|-------------|
40	| **1. Create pages** | The SEO team form: business name, website, phones, contact link, services (one per line), keywords (one line per service, comma separated), locations, images per service (Media Library picker, "Auto-fill images", "Use for all"), drafts or publish, skip or rewrite existing pages, FAQs per page, extra notes. |
41	| **2. Progress & report** | Live progress bar. Pages are written in parallel (default 4 at a time). Table of every page with keyword, status, notes, View and Edit links. Buttons: Pause, Resume, Retry failed, Publish all drafts, Move pages to trash. |
42	| **Design** | On Divi or Elementor Pro sites: a card that links to the Theme Builder template (edit there, all Area pages change). On sites without a builder: the plugin's own layout editor (sections show/hide, drag order, styles, live preview, export/import). |
43	| **Menu & hub page** | Option 1: add "Areas We Serve > Location > Services" (or "> Service > Locations") to an existing site menu, only plugin-made items are ever touched, auto-updates when pages are published. Option 2: create an "Areas We Serve" hub page (`/service-areas/`) with a banner and one card per location listing its services. Drag to order locations and services. |
44	| **Setup** | **"Set up this site"** one click: installs and activates ACF if missing, imports the ACF export into the ACF database (field group with 61 fields, post type, taxonomy, editable in ACF like before), detects the builder and installs the SCO layout into Divi Theme Builder (or Elementor Pro Theme Builder) assigned to "All Areas We Serve", using the site's global header and footer, brand colors and Divi global fonts. Running it again keeps an existing template (Theme Builder edits are not overwritten) unless "Install a fresh copy" is ticked. |
45	| **AI & images** | AI provider (Claude or OpenAI), API key (stored encrypted, never shown again), writing speed (Fast default / Best quality), pages at the same time (1 to 8), optional model override, Test connection. Optional free Pexels API key for stock photos when the Media Library has too few matching images. |
46	
47	How a page is made: for each Service x Location, the plugin asks the AI for one JSON object with all text fields (rules from the team's prompt are in the system prompt), checks it (word counts, location in headings, title case, banned words "professional/reliable/expert" in section 2 heading, repeated sentences, meta length), asks again only for serious problems (max 2 AI calls per page), then fills fixed fields in code (post title "{Service} in {Location}", page heading "Best {Service} in {Location}", phone as `tel:+1XXXXXXXXXX`, contact link, images by the team's image rules, alt tags), saves all ACF fields, Yoast and Rank Math title, description and focus keyword, Location term, featured image. FAQ schema (FAQPage JSON-LD) is added on every Area page.
48	
49	## 4. Version history
50	
51	| Version | What changed |
52	|---------|-------------|
53	| 1.0.0 | First release: Keyword Adder module, modular plugin core, security layer. |
54	| 1.1.0 | Area Pages module: post type, ACF fields, AI writer, job queue, built-in template, Divi/Elementor installers (advanced). |
55	| 1.1.1 | Fixes from the first live test: new Claude models reject `temperature`; extended thinking used all tokens (thinking now disabled, budget 16000); one AI call per request; job pauses after 3 identical failures; phone "814.834.1700" was cut to "834.1700"; better Divi color detection. |
56	| 1.2.0 | Layout editor inside the plugin, one-click ACF setup, automatic images (Media Library match + Pexels). |
57	| 1.2.1 | Brand color list limited to the real site colors (Divi had 598 stored global colors). Click a section in the preview to edit it. |
58	| 1.2.2 | Default design became a copy of the team's SCO layout. Second brand color. |
59	| 1.3.0 | Setup auto-detects the builder and installs SCO into Divi/Elementor Theme Builder. Menu builder and hub page. |
60	| 1.3.1 | Speed: parallel writing (default 4), retries only for serious problems, "Fast" model default. Divi template now uses the site's global Theme Builder header and footer (older templates repaired automatically on first admin load). SCO fixed fonts (Chivo, Roboto Flex) replaced with Divi global heading/body fonts. |
61	| 1.4.0 | Images: different photos on every page automatically (per-service photo pool from the Media Library, rotated per location; logos, badges, team headshots and other services' photos excluded; general shop photos only as a last fill). Optional (default on) SEO copies: each page gets its own copy of its photos named `{keyword}-in-{location}-N.jpg` with the page alt text (files and sizes copied, no resizing, reused on rewrite). Report button "Different images on every page" fixes old jobs without AI. Phone and contact page auto-read from the site. New filter `seo_boster_image_library` (used for tests). |
62	| 1.5.0 | Any AI provider: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, xAI, or Custom (any OpenAI-compatible address). One encrypted key per provider (old single key migrates automatically). "Show my models" lists models from the provider's /models endpoint. Empty model = automatic: provider default, or picked from the model list (and re-picked once if the model is not found). Request self-adjusts on 400 errors (thinking, response_format, max_tokens vs max_completion_tokens, token cap 8192). `<think>` blocks stripped. Custom addresses use wp_safe_remote_* (no internal network). Filter `seo_boster_ai_providers`. Only tested with mocked APIs; real keys of the new providers not tested yet. |
63	| 1.6.0 | Automatic menu: `SEOB_AP_Nav::live_menu()` finds the menu in the header theme location (Divi `primary-menu` etc.). Setting `auto` (default on) builds the block on the first publish and rebuilds it on every publish/unpublish of an Area page, once per request on `shutdown`. One-time `admin_init` sync (`seob_ap_menu_first`) for sites with pages already published. Block goes before the first top-level Contact/Book/Quote item; the top item has meta `_seob_ap_menu_top` and its position is kept on rebuild (items after it are renumbered). "Remove from menu" sets `auto` to 0. Menu select value 0 = live header menu. Not yet tested on a real Divi site (check the mobile menu). |
64	| 1.7.0 | New `class-seob-ap-style.php` + `assets/js/site-style.js`: admin loads the homepage in hidden iframes (1280, 820, 390 px), measures visible h1-h4, body p and buttons outside header/footer/nav (most common style wins), saves to option `seob_ap_site_style` via AJAX (every value validated). Front: body class `seob-match` on Area pages and hub; CSS with !important scoped to `.et-l--body`, `.elementor-location-single`, `.seob-area`; tablet/phone media queries; homepage Google/Bunny/Typekit font links re-printed. Toggle on Design tab; button colors optional (off by default so buttons stay visible on brand-color sections). Menu items get classes `seob-aws` / `seob-aws-top` (+ `mega-menu` on Divi with 5+ locations); footer CSS/JS makes Divi `.et_mobile_menu` items tap-to-open. If a site sends X-Frame-Options DENY the measurement fails and the layout keeps its own sizes (shown on the Design tab). Tested locally on Twenty Twenty-Five (sizes match exactly); not yet on a real Divi site. |
65	| 1.8.0 | Magnific (ex Freepik) stock photos, default image source. API: `GET https://api.magnific.com/v1/resources` (term, page, limit, filters[content_type][photo]=1, filters[orientation][landscape]=1), `GET /v1/resources/{id}/download?image_size=medium` -> data.url; header `x-magnific-api-key`. Search results cached 1 day per term (transient `seob_mg_*`); page with location index L takes results L*4..L*4+3 (later rounds on 403 premium). Downloads marked `_seob_magnific_id` (reused) and `_seob_ap_page_only` (renamed/alt for the page instead of copied). Job setting `image_source` = magnific when the site source is Magnific and the mode is per page; hand-picked cells for a service switch that service back to library logic. Agency key in `includes/agency-config.php` (`SEOB_DEFAULT_MAGNIFIC_KEY`); site key and `SEOB_MAGNIFIC_KEY` constant override it. Magnific API was not reachable from the build machine (proxy), so it is tested only with a mocked API: press "Test Magnific" on a real site first. |
66	| 1.8.1 | Exact button clone. `assets/js/site-style.js` groups homepage buttons by look; most common = `btn`, next different look = `btn2` (outline / second button). Hover read from the site's own same-origin CSS `:hover` rules (sorted by specificity, important last), applied to a hidden clone of the button to resolve variables, shorthands and em sizes, saved as `btn_hover` / `btn2_hover`. New props: backgroundImage (gradients only), boxShadow, fontStyle, textDecorationLine, transitionDuration (all validated in `clean_value`). CSS scope now `body.seob-match:not(#seob-x1):not(#seob-x2) ...` so it beats Divi/Elementor module rules like `body #page-container ... !important`. Default `buttons` = all (migration via option key `v`); `dv` data version forces a re-measure. Design tab has a live preview (`SEOB_AP_Style::preview()`). Tested locally: main and second button identical to the homepage at rest and on hover, even against a competing `!important` rule. Cross-domain CSS files (CDN) cannot be read for hover; then no hover is copied. |
67	| 1.8.2 | Site look baked into the Theme Builder template (`class-seob-ap-bake.php`). Divi: regex over module shortcodes in the `et_body_layout` linked from the SEO Boster `et_template`; sets et_pb_text header/header_2/3/4/text font (`Family|weight|italic|upper|underline||||`), size + tablet/phone + `_last_edited on|phone`, line height (em), letter spacing; accordion toggle/body; `dnxte_dual_button` btn_one/two fonts, colors, bg, radius, border, padding, hover bg/text/border, shadow/gradient/transition in `custom_css_button_*_link`; `et_pb_button` custom_button fields. Elementor: heading/text-editor/button/accordion typography and button colors/hover/border/padding in `_elementor_data`. Runs once: on template install, on first measurement, or via admin_init `maybe_bake` when not yet baked; manual "Copy the site look again" re-applies (sends `apply=1`). Option keys `baked` (mode) and `baked_time`. When baked, front CSS only targets `.seob-area` (built-in template / hub), so Theme Builder edits always win. Layout editor removed for Divi/Elementor modes. Tested locally with the real layout files (152 modules, 53 dynamic fields unchanged, idempotent); not yet tested on a live Divi site. |

Desktop CSS/JS in `SEOB_AP_Style::menu_script()`: third level at `left:100%`, top aligned to the hovered row, `seob-flip` opens it to the left when it would leave the screen, right-pointing chevrons. # SEO Boster: Project Handoff

Last updated: 16 November 2026. Plugin version at handoff: **1.3.1**.

---

## 1. People and context

- **Plugin author name (as shown in WordPress):** Rajvardhan Singh Rathore.
- **Who uses it:** a web agency's SEO and web team. They build service-business websites (mostly WordPress with Divi, some Elementor) and create many local SEO landing pages per client.
- **The person who commissioned this work** speaks Hinglish (Hindi + English in Latin script) and prefers short, clear answers. They do not want em dashes or en dashes in written replies.
- **Their computer:** Windows. Working folder: `C:\Users\digit\OneDrive\Desktop\SEO DESGIN PROCESS\` (this HANDOFF folder lives inside it).

## 2. The goal

Replace a slow manual process for building **"Areas We Serve" pages** (one page for every Service x Location combination, for example 8 services x 10 cities = 80 pages) with **one WordPress plugin** that does everything with as few clicks as possible, works on any client site, and keeps each site's data separate.

### The old manual process (what the plugin replaces)

1. Install the ACF plugin, import `inputs/acf-export-2025-12-20.json` (field group "Locations", post type `areas-we-serve`, taxonomy `location`).
2. Install the WP Ultimate CSV Importer Pro plugin.
3. Upload client images to the Media Library, copy their URLs.
4. Paste business name, services, keywords, locations, phone numbers and image URLs into a fixed ChatGPT prompt (`inputs/seo-team-chatgpt-prompt.txt`) to get a CSV.
5. Import the CSV into the "Areas We Serve" post type.
6. In Divi > Theme Builder, add a template for "All Areas We Serve", import `inputs/SCO Layout.json`, adjust branding (fonts, colors, buttons) to match the site.
7. Edit any single page later through its ACF fields in the WordPress editor.

## 3. What the plugin does now (v1.9.0)

Menu: **WordPress admin > SEO Boster**. It is built from modules; each module is a card on the SEO Boster dashboard and can be turned on or off.

### Module A: Keyword Adder (v1.0.0)
Paste keywords. The plugin scores every page (title, URL, Yoast or Rank Math focus keyphrase, page text, synonyms such as corp = corporation, LLC = limited liability company, WY = Wyoming), picks the best page per keyword, writes a natural sentence containing it, lets you review or change everything, then adds the lines to the pages (rendered through `the_content`, the page's own content is never rewritten). Report shows page, line number, exact text, and a direct link to the line (`page-url#seob-line-3`). Undo per keyword or per run. CSV export.

### Module B: Area Pages (v1.1.0 to v1.3.1)
Tabs inside **SEO Boster > Area Pages**:

| Tab | What it does |
|-----|-------------|
| **1. Create pages** | The SEO team form: business name, website, phones, contact link, services (one per line), keywords (one line per service, comma separated), locations, images per service (Media Library picker, "Auto-fill images", "Use for all"), drafts or publish, skip or rewrite existing pages, FAQs per page, extra notes. |
| **2. Progress & report** | Live progress bar. Pages are written in parallel (default 4 at a time). Table of every page with keyword, status, notes, View and Edit links. Buttons: Pause, Resume, Retry failed, Publish all drafts, Move pages to trash. |
| **Design** | On Divi or Elementor Pro sites: a card that links to the Theme Builder template (edit there, all Area pages change). On sites without a builder: the plugin's own layout editor (sections show/hide, drag order, styles, live preview, export/import). |
| **Menu & hub page** | Option 1: add "Areas We Serve > Location > Services" (or "> Service > Locations") to an existing site menu, only plugin-made items are ever touched, auto-updates when pages are published. Option 2: create an "Areas We Serve" hub page (`/service-areas/`) with a banner and one card per location listing its services. Drag to order locations and services. |
| **Setup** | **"Set up this site"** one click: installs and activates ACF if missing, imports the ACF export into the ACF database (field group with 61 fields, post type, taxonomy, editable in ACF like before), detects the builder and installs the SCO layout into Divi Theme Builder (or Elementor Pro Theme Builder) assigned to "All Areas We Serve", using the site's global header and footer, brand colors and Divi global fonts. Running it again keeps an existing template (Theme Builder edits are not overwritten) unless "Install a fresh copy" is ticked. |
| **AI & images** | AI provider (Claude or OpenAI), API key (stored encrypted, never shown again), writing speed (Fast default / Best quality), pages at the same time (1 to 8), optional model override, Test connection. Optional free Pexels API key for stock photos when the Media Library has too few matching images. |

How a page is made: for each Service x Location, the plugin asks the AI for one JSON object with all text fields (rules from the team's prompt are in the system prompt), checks it (word counts, location in headings, title case, banned words "professional/reliable/expert" in section 2 heading, repeated sentences, meta length), asks again only for serious problems (max 2 AI calls per page), then fills fixed fields in code (post title "{Service} in {Location}", page heading "Best {Service} in {Location}", phone as `tel:+1XXXXXXXXXX`, contact link, images by the team's image rules, alt tags), saves all ACF fields, Yoast and Rank Math title, description and focus keyword, Location term, featured image. FAQ schema (FAQPage JSON-LD) is added on every Area page.

## 4. Version history

| Version | What changed |
|---------|-------------|
| 1.0.0 | First release: Keyword Adder module, modular plugin core, security layer. |
| 1.1.0 | Area Pages module: post type, ACF fields, AI writer, job queue, built-in template, Divi/Elementor installers (advanced). |
| 1.1.1 | Fixes from the first live test: new Claude models reject `temperature`; extended thinking used all tokens (thinking now disabled, budget 16000); one AI call per request; job pauses after 3 identical failures; phone "814.834.1700" was cut to "834.1700"; better Divi color detection. |
| 1.2.0 | Layout editor inside the plugin, one-click ACF setup, automatic images (Media Library match + Pexels). |
| 1.2.1 | Brand color list limited to the real site colors (Divi had 598 stored global colors). Click a section in the preview to edit it. |
| 1.2.2 | Default design became a copy of the team's SCO layout. Second brand color. |
| 1.3.0 | Setup auto-detects the builder and installs SCO into Divi/Elementor Theme Builder. Menu builder and hub page. |
| 1.3.1 | Speed: parallel writing (default 4), retries only for serious problems, "Fast" model default. Divi template now uses the site's global Theme Builder header and footer (older templates repaired automatically on first admin load). SCO fixed fonts (Chivo, Roboto Flex) replaced with Divi global heading/body fonts. |
| 1.4.0 | Images: different photos on every page automatically (per-service photo pool from the Media Library, rotated per location; logos, badges, team headshots and other services' photos excluded; general shop photos only as a last fill). Optional (default on) SEO copies: each page gets its own copy of its photos named `{keyword}-in-{location}-N.jpg` with the page alt text (files and sizes copied, no resizing, reused on rewrite). Report button "Different images on every page" fixes old jobs without AI. Phone and contact page auto-read from the site. New filter `seo_boster_image_library` (used for tests). |
| 1.5.0 | Any AI provider: Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, xAI, or Custom (any OpenAI-compatible address). One encrypted key per provider (old single key migrates automatically). "Show my models" lists models from the provider's /models endpoint. Empty model = automatic: provider default, or picked from the model list (and re-picked once if the model is not found). Request self-adjusts on 400 errors (thinking, response_format, max_tokens vs max_completion_tokens, token cap 8192). `<think>` blocks stripped. Custom addresses use wp_safe_remote_* (no internal network). Filter `seo_boster_ai_providers`. Only tested with mocked APIs; real keys of the new providers not tested yet. |

Setting `auto` (default on) builds the block on the first publish and rebuilds it on every publish/unpublish of an Area page, once per request on `shutdown`. Menu items get classes `seob-aws` / `seob-aws-top` (+ `mega-menu` on Divi with 5+ locations); footer CSS/JS makes Divi `.et_mobile_menu` items tap-to-open. Tested locally on Twenty Twenty-Five (sizes match exactly); not yet on a real Divi site. |

input.content:
# SEO Boster: project ki poori kahani

Shuru se 20 November 2026 tak. Technical detail ke liye `03-DOCS/HANDOFF.md` (section 4: har version) aur `03-DOCS/DEVELOPER-GUIDE.md` dekho.

---

## 1. Shuruaat: inclegals.com ka SEO kaam

Pehla kaam ek client site ka tha: **inclegals.com** (Divi, Yoast). Client chahta tha ki site sirf "Nevada" target na kare (woh poori duniya mein kaam karte hain) aur 25 keywords add hon (aged corp, shelf corp, aged LLC, Nevada/WY corp aur LLC, limited liability company, "for sale" ke saath aur bina).

Kya hua (11 November 2026):
- 9 pages ke Yoast titles aur descriptions worldwide kiye.
- Focus keyphrases set kiye.
- 3 pages par FAQ accordion mein keywords wale sawaal add kiye. Saare 25 keywords page text mein check kiye.

Baaki: 6 pages ke H1 mein abhi bhi "in Nevada" hai (aapse poochna tha), aur client ke Google Doc mein comment karna hai.

## 2. Idea: ek plugin jo yeh sab automatic kare

Isi kaam se idea aaya: **SEO Boster** naam ka WordPress plugin (author: Rajvardhan Singh Rathore), modules mein bana hua.

**Module 1: Keyword Adder (v1.0.0).** Keywords paste karo, plugin har page ko score karta hai (title, URL, Yoast/Rank Math keyphrase, text, synonyms jaise corp = corporation), sabse sahi page chunta hai, natural line likhta hai, aap review karte ho, phir add hota hai. Page ka asli content kabhi nahi badalta. Report mein exact line ka link, undo, CSV.

## 3. Bada kaam: Areas We Serve pages (Module 2: Area Pages)

**Purana manual tareeka (SEO team ka):** ACF install, ACF export import, CSV importer plugin, images upload karke URLs copy, ChatGPT prompt mein sab paste karke CSV banana, CSV import, Divi Theme Builder mein SCO layout import karke branding theek karna. Har client ke liye ghante lagte the.

**Aapka goal:** sab kuch automatic aur one click. Design ek jagah se edit ho. ACF fields bilkul purane jaise. Speed. Har site ka data alag.

Versions ke saath kya bana:

| Version | Kya hua (simple shabdon mein) |
|---|---|
| 1.1.0 | Area Pages module: form, AI writer, job queue, ACF fields, Divi/Elementor installer |
| 1.1.1 | Pehle live test ke fixes (Claude ka temperature bug, phone number katna) |
| 1.2.x | Plugin ke andar layout editor, ek click ACF setup, automatic images, site ke brand colors |
| 1.3.0 | Setup khud builder pehchanta hai aur SCO layout Theme Builder mein daalta hai. Menu builder aur hub page |
| 1.3.1 | Speed: 4 pages ek saath likhte hain. Site ka global header/footer. Divi ke global fonts |
| 1.4.0 | Har page par alag photos automatic, SEO file names ke saath (SEO team pehle haath se lagati thi) |
| 1.5.0 | Koi bhi AI provider ki API key |
| 1.6.0 | Menu automatic: live header menu mein "Areas We Serve > Location > Services" |
| 1.7.0 | Site jaisa look: plugin homepage padhkar fonts aur sizes copy karta hai |
| 1.8.0 | Magnific se photos, agency key plugin mein built-in |
| 1.8.1 | Buttons ki exact copy (colors, hover, shadow) |
| 1.8.2 | Design sirf Theme Builder se. Site ka look template ke andar likha jaata hai. "Advanced layout editor" builder sites se hataya |
| 1.8.3 | Demo site par menu ka dropdown bigad raha tha (12 locations ek doosre par). Fix: saaf list, services side mein |
| 1.8.4 | "Auto-fill images" ab har cell bharta hai, haath se kuch nahi |
| 1.8.5 | Demo site par buttons alag dikh rahe the, white text halke color par tha, phone par Contact button chhupa tha, FAQ chhota tha. Sab fix |
| 1.9.0 | Aapka naya Theme Builder layout (5 sections). Har site ke colors aur typography automatic. Image grid mein sirf woh photos jo template use karta hai |

## 4. Sites jahan test hua

- **Penn Pallet** (lmgdemo2.com/penn, Divi): pehla test site (v1.3.x). Yahan bugs mile aur fix hue.
